Raise: Not done
The published summary retains every prior interval, full round lines and finding lists, and every distinct finding in `seen`. Its size therefore keeps growing with the item's history. The 20-round proof checks only that one body stays below 40 KB; it does not establish a bound for longer items or rounds with more findings. Once the retained summary alone exceeds GitHub's limit, `_bounded_body` can remove current rows but has no way to shrink that summary, so publication can fail and the promised complete history is not kept.
